tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so/ /

byin rlabs rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /dang po nyid du phyag 'tshal te/ /gsang sngags nye lam zab mo'i gnad/ /bla ma yid bzhin nor bu bri/ /dang po kho nar dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i gnas su dmigs pa'i bla ma'i sku 'dra yod na'ang bkram la/ phyi nang gi tshogs mchod bshams te/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ ā+oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ gis stong par bsam pa'i ngang las rang nyid yi dam kun tu bzang po yab yum mthing ka rdo rje skyil krung can/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i phyag rgya bsnol ba/ 'od zer mu med pa 'phro bar bsam pa'i spyi gtsug tu pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su a ljang ser las/ bi ma la mi tra sku mdog ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na/ thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ rdo rje skyil krung can/ chos gos dmar ser gsol ba/ paṇ+ḍi'i ta'i cha byad can/ shangs kyi rtse na a dkar ljang 'thig la khad pa yod pa'i rtse las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du ri bo rtse lnga nas bi ma la mi tra de 'dra ba zhig la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa tsam skad cig gis byon nas/ spyi gtsug gi bla ma la thim pas 'od dang 'od zer du 'bar nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang zhing khams dag pa'i rang bzhin nang bcud sems can thams cad dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i rang bzhin/ snang ba thams cad 'od dang gdangs su khyil li li bar bsam pa'i/ bla ma'i phyogs bzhir rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang mo/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyur zhing g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thugs kar bsnams pa'i gru mo na kha ṭāṃ ga bsnams shing*/

zhabs g.yas bskums pa'i rting pa bha gar gtad cing g.yon brkyang pas pad+ma nyi ma ro'i steng na gar stabs ling ling byed pas/ phyogs mtshams kyi nam mkha' thams cad gang nas phaṭa dang hūṃ sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam la/ rlung kha sbyar te ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa byed na bla ma'i thugs kar pad nyi'i dbus su a ldang khu/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar ha/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la ri/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro la ni/ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar sa bsam pa las/ sngags kyi rang sgra di ri ri byung bas/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad la khyab par bsam la/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ ghu ru bi ma la ha ri ni sa tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza sid+dhi pha la hūṃ aḥ zhes ci 'grub tu bzlas pa'i mthar snang srid thams cad bla ma la thim/ bla ma rang gi snying kar thim nas/ rang yang dmigs su med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la dar cig mnyam par gzhag go /rjes snang rmi lam sgyu ma'i ngang las/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i rnam par gsal btab la/ 'gro ba dang 'dug pa la sogs pa bya zhing*/ gtor tshogs bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsal btab la rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rjes la/ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul nas/ /dngos grub chen po rtsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab cing*/ rten rnams rang la bsdu bar bya'o/ /de ltar zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgrubs pas/ dngos su bag dro zhing byin che la/ lta ba dang sgom pa'i rtogs pa dang nus mthu phyogs med du skye la/ nyams snang du bla ma mkha' 'gro yod pa snyam pa dang*/ rmi lam du paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ rab tu byung ba rnam dag dang*/ khye'u dang*/ bu mo dang*/ bud med rgyan chas brgyan pa mang po rmi zhing*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ dar phyar ba dang*/ rnga brdung ba dang*/ dung 'bud pa dang*/ me tog gi tshal la 'dug pa la sogs pa rmi'o/ /'dis ni tshe 'dir mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/

/de ltar bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /bla ma'i go 'phang mtha' yas thob par shog /bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/ / dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (10)bla ma yid bzhin nor bu/ - PAGE 156 -- PAGE 157 -- PAGE 155 -
